model_output.rationale: 835 denies all four lines CO-16 with claim-level MOA N286 — missing/invalid referring provider identifier. The 837P carries no referring-provider loop (only NM1*82 rendering, CLARK MARY). GP and KX are present on every line, so this is not a therapy-modifier or threshold denial. CO-16 + N286 is the documented data-defect signature: fix the ordering/referring name and NPI and resubmit as a new original; do not appeal, do not bill the patient.
